description: This file provides simple frontend JavaScript logic for managing coupon codes in a shopping platform. It contains data defining demo coupons, functions to validate coupon codes entered by users, and to calculate discount amounts based on those coupons. It is likely used in a React frontend to handle coupon validation and discount calculation without backend API calls.

methods.name: validateCoupon(inputCode, cartTotal)
methods.description: Validates the user input coupon code against predefined demo coupons, checking validity, expiry, and conditions like minimum order value.

methods.name: getDiscountAmount(cartTotal, appliedCoupon)
methods.description: Calculates the discount amount based on the total cart value and the applied coupon object.
